question: Should OpenClaw publish an OpenAPI/Swagger contract, and if so should the first supported scope be stable Gateway HTTP endpoints only or the broader Gateway RPC/plugin surface?
rationale: The code already has TypeBox protocol schemas and multiple HTTP/plugin surfaces, but choosing what becomes a public OpenAPI contract affects compatibility, security documentation, and future generated-client support.

options.title: HTTP endpoints first
options.body: Publish a versioned OpenAPI contract for the stable Gateway HTTP endpoints and leave WebSocket RPC/plugin routes on the existing TypeBox protocol path until separately designed.

options.title: SDK/protocol path instead
options.body: Decline OpenAPI for now and invest in the existing TypeBox JSON Schema plus generated SDK/client workflow as the supported programmatic contract.

options.title: Broader API design
options.body: Open a larger API design effort covering HTTP, WebSocket RPC, and plugin route schema publication together before any implementation.

recommendation.title: HTTP endpoints first
recommendation.body: Publish a versioned OpenAPI contract for the stable Gateway HTTP endpoints and leave WebSocket RPC/plugin routes on the existing TypeBox protocol path until separately designed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway/protocol/API history makes steipete the strongest routing owner for choosing the public contract scope.
